reviews.t: Easiest lashes with the best results!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:3232f0b684ad684bea9db2935575d7d3]] I’m used to getting lashes applied and for it to take hours! This took less than 5 minutes from start to finish. This was so easy to apply and the lashes look fabulous! You do have to be sure for the magnetic eyeliner to completely dry before applying the lashes. Thank you!
[[VIDEOID:24562283773e4f9861d1d1d45812d017]] I wanted something i could use everyday without destroying my natural lashes and without having to deal with glue. These are absolutely perfect.

The lashes were very high quality and lasted all day. I was surprised by how lightweight they were because usually fake lashes make my eyelids feel very heavy. There were a range of styles for different occasions, and I liked how I could either go natural or full glam. These lashes were so much easier to put on than regular falsies with lash glue. The eyeliner was also very pigmented and lasted all day, and was comparable to the eyeliner I use daily. Overall I would highly recommend these lashes

reviews.t: I am hooked on these lashes!
reviews.x: Highly recommended by a friend who weats them daily. This is my first set of lashes ever and I am in love. Easy to apply and remove. I love the variety of lengths in this set. I am wearing the shortest ones and the longest ones in these pictures. My husband even loved them! These cost of fraction of more popular designer lines and you get 6 pairs and double the liner versus 1 pair. Lashes as super soft and lightweight. You won't regret buying them.

I am in love with these magnetic lashes! They're so incredibly easy to use, and the set makes it easy to choose from, depending on your day (office or a night out). I loathe the glue on eyelashes; I have never had luck with them. These magnetic lashes are a game changer. If you are on the fence about trying them, just go for it! You won't be disappointed 🤩
I honestly didn’t expect these to work, but they look great!

Love them!! The only problem I had was that with  the 4th pair from the top (in the one with 6) had some lashes missing from one...like a gap in the middle. It looked like maybe they had fallen out at some point. So I had to throw that pair out, but even given that, it’s still worth it for the price. Make sure you cover the corners of your eyes really well as that’s where they had a tendency to come loose. I’ve also used these with another brand of gel liner and it works great. I’ll likely buy t

I've always wanted to try out "magnetic falsies" so I took a chance &bought these. These are such a game changer! I mean you still have to use the eyeliner which is like the glue, but it's not as messy. The eyelashes came in such a cute box with 2 eyeliners and a tweezer. My only concern is when these eyeliner runs out, how compatible other "magnetic eyeliners" would work with these.

reviews.t: easy to apply and easy to remove
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:6470653c3a5575c32543947700806bfc]] the packaging looks fancy, and i test the eye liner and the magnetic eyeliner first at the back of my hand to see if theres any alergic reaction and wait the next day to wipe it off, for me there is no alergic reaction, its easy to apply and its easy to remove. i will highly recomend this product if you want something classy and fancy.
[[VIDEOID:efa779a0d04d6788975bab2ad764708b]] I like the different variety of lashes and the sparkly box it comes in. Very easy to apply after eyeliner dries
This are so much more easier to put on. Putting on lashes would take me about 10 mins but now with these lashes I am able to do it within minutes. I would recommend you get these.

I would recommend this kit highly. It comes with 6 pairs of differently styled eyelashes. At first I felt the more full and long ones were overly dramatic and I'd only get use out of the most conservative pair. However, after some practice and change to my eyeshadow I think I can get away with wearing almost all of them without need of a special occasion. The two most dramatic eyelashes might be useful for an event and is nice to have just in case. I recommend cutting them to fit, triple layerin
Quick, easy, comfortable, beautiful...no more trips to the shop or glue. Very secure & durable, but easy to remove. I forgot I was wearing them 😊

The packaging was really pretty, everything looks high quality it was impressive to see. It comes with two liners and 6 different style lashes, the liner was easy to apply and didn’t take too long to apply. I have tried others in the past that were more expensive and sold by the pair and the liner took forever to dry or you had to use a lot of it. This one I didn’t need too thick of a liner and the lash attached very quickly and easily without removing the whole line when I adjusted. They lasted

I found the glue start to lose its grip even after shaking the heck out of the tubes (as read the magnetic particles sink). After the second time the glue just wouldn’t magnetized well even after I cleaned the lashes off. Then one side would stick properly but then if another side would stick too high for example and you

I tested the magnetic mascara and eyelashes and they stuck on quite easily and effectively on my hand. I live the different eyelashes looks you get with this and it is quite affordable. I love it and can't wait to use it to go out

I'm very disappointed 😞. I was expecting the liner to hold the magnetic lashes on my eyelid. Each time that I would adjust the lash, the eyeliner would peel off my eyelid and sticking to the magnetic lash. Smh

reviews.t: lashes are soft, packaging slightly misleading in pictures, No little lights around mirror!
reviews.x: When my package arrived I was so excited! When I opened it up I realized the package was damaged the case to my lashes is ripped slightly and smashed in on the side at the corner the lid was out of alignment with the box and when I opened it I realized the mirror didn’t light up in one of the pictures of the product it looks like the mirror as little lights around it which I thought to be cute, is is why I chose this product over others by the way so I was disappointed to say the lest. How ever

The packaging/presentation was very nice and so are the lashes themselves; however, they became loose approximately 3 hours after use; additionally I could reuse them since they wouldn’t latch onto the liner. This is not my first time using magnetic lashes so I think it’s safe to say they are not what they advertise. Steer clear and don’t buy these.

reviews.t: Very high quality lashes but takes practice to apply
reviews.x: The quality of the lashes is excellent and the magnetic eyeliner is very easy to apply. The corners of the lashes can be difficult to get to stick but with practice it gets easier.

reviews.t: And the packaging is pretty too
reviews.x: Glittery rose gold box, two liners, 6 lashes and magnetic tweezers - YES PLEASE. I really like that the box also has a mirror - performers dream. I like the thin liner brush. I can get close to my lash liner without needing a lot of liner, it also does not get on my natural lashes, which can hurt when taking off. If you do get it on your natural lashes, just use a q-tip with makeup remover and wipe away. The variety is nice. I did cut off the last magnetic on each lash set. I do not like the fir

Initially they stick to the liner well but in about 4 hours I notice the ends start lifting and the magnet has lifted the liner off my eyelid. I get small windows on my eyeliner. The lashes can't be repositioned because of this... i've tried different things including layering better eyeliner on the bottom, more magnetic eyeliner, the ends still lift. Last resort was cutting off the magnet in the inner corners to make the strips shorter, they feel better but the liner still doesnt adhere to my l

Ok I wanted to try these to see if they were any easier than the regular glue lashes. So the packaging was great. The box has glitter covering it. It is a lid box which you lift to see the lashes. There is a mirror on the inside and the trays of lashes. Using the glue with these lashes was just like using the regular glue. To me these where no different than the regular strip lashes. It took about the same amount of the to put these on. Also about the same amount of the time for the glue to get

I didn't like how the product came with a tweezer that you can use to stick on the lashes because if the eyeliner is supposed to be magnetic then y would you use a metal object such as the tweezers. That automatically gives the chance of the tweezers sticking and messing up the placement if the lashes. I would suggest a plastic tweezer instead.  Also the eyeliner didn't really last for a long time. My eyelashes would start to lift and peel off after about 2 hours maz after i put it on.

Application is simple. However I was only able to wear one pair twice I clean the eyeliner off the magnets With tweezers Then place them back on the magnets attached to the packaging. The next time I used the tweezers to pulled them off to wear them again one of the magnets stuck to the packaging magnet. I’m Disappointed that the lashes fell apart in the magnet stuck to the magnet on the packaging.  My favorite 1st pair are ruined. Please send me a replacement.  Thank you

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the lashes as easy and quick to apply, often compared to glue lashes.
Many reviewers praise the variety of lash styles and lengths included in the set.
Several reviewers highlight the lashes as lightweight and comfortable to wear.
Some reviewers note issues with the magnetic eyeliner/glue, including drying time and losing grip.
A few reviewers mention quality or durability problems such as missing lashes or lashes coming off.
